## 9. Extraordinary Pension  
[ Swamy's Extraordinary Pension Rules]  
If an employee sustains injuries, diseases or dies and the injury, disease or death is attributable to Government service, he/his family becomes eligible for the grant of an award under the Central Civil Services (Extraordinary Pension) Rules, 1939 which are applicable to all employees except to  
those to whom the Workmen's Compensation Act, 1923, applies.
